scope: Known Apple-specific instructions and architectural behavior, excluded from the documented standard A64 denominator. A tracked group is not one instruction or a complete extension inventory. Standard PAuth instructions belong in the A64 checklist; Apple ABI/key-lifetime work is tracked with platform services.

extensions.scope: Apple matrix accelerator instructions; opcode operations 0..22 are described by firsthand research, with generation-dependent submodes. SET/CLR share operation17. Full generation/submode inventory and semantics remain open.
extensions.observation: Static aligned AMX encoding matches in original macOS26A434 Accelerate __text: BLAS159291, BNNS59950, vDSP7970, LAPACK109539. Reachability/hardware execution are unverified. Feature dispatch can select other paths; no profile requirement inferred from presence alone.

extensions.scope: Apple-specific system-register meanings and protection/ordering controls. Standard MRS/MSR/SYS encoding coverage does not establish the selected register semantics.
extensions.observation: Public XNU defines ACTLR EnTSO/EnAPFLG/EnAFP/EnPRSV. Original dyld uses S3_6_C15_C1_5 on conditional protection paths. Exact private semantics/profile availability remain unverified.

extensions.scope: Apple reserved-NZCV parity/adjust and related flag behavior used by generated Rosetta ARM code. This does not imply a requirement for ordinary native ARM applications.
extensions.observation: Pinned original Rosetta output reads NZCV bit26; six of eight parity fixtures differ on generic Unicorn. Code is preserved unchanged; no Apple hardware validation. See docs/research/rosetta.md.
